blocks.text: Today's tag is $16.87, and that is what will be billed.
The card step will not raise it.
Glass coaster is available for twelve dollars and seventy nine cents and is not ticked.
Ordinary carrier cost is already inside today's tag. No packing line is added.
The shelf card lists fourteen on hand in the stockroom.
Last week's tag on Linen washcloth, pair was thirty six dollars and forty five cents.
